entries.proposition: Table 2 gives, for breast cancer, loss of WWOX activating aerobic glycolysis with increased glucose uptake and GLUT1 expression: a loss-of-function metabolic sign in tumour cells (glycolysis up), opposite to the hypoglycemia of the whole-body null mouse; the review does not remark on the difference.
entries.snippet: Loss of WWOX activates aerobic glycolysis, increasing glucose uptake and GLUT1 expression

entries.snippet: Specific homozygous mutations result in premature stop codons that disrupt normal brain development, causing abnormalities like cerebellar vermis hypoplasia and impaired neuronal migration.
